title: Rejected scheduled awaitable hooks remain live and mutate state after failure
description: Fresh final timing security review: _reject_awaitable and LinkLayer elevation guards close coroutine objects but do not cancel asyncio.Task/Future or other scheduled awaitables. A synchronous persistence hook can return asyncio.create_task(later_persist(state)); ProvisionVerifier.install raises TypeError, then the task runs on the next loop turn and durably advances rejected state. Use one common rejection helper that synchronously cancels Future/Task, closes coroutine/custom-closeable awaitables, and verifies termination where possible before failing closed. Add scheduled Task/Future/custom awaitable tests for provision persist/clear, MonotonicClock, verified receipt, authenticated DIO, and time-generation callbacks.
